Audience: every first-time Oregon Class C applicant; restraint, headlight and bad-weather rules are everyday driving law and recurring knowledge-test material.
Why it matters to a first-timer: child restraint rules turn on an exact age and height [A02], the headlight dimming distances differ for oncoming and followed vehicles [A04], and skid recovery runs against the instinct to brake [A07].
Level: exact-number recall (child seat age and height, headlight distances, studded tire dates) plus step-sequence recall for running off the road and skids; moderate to heavy load.
Prerequisites: the lane travel sections, especially following distance and the basic rule, and the sharing-the-road sections, especially vulnerable road users.
